note: Double-differential antineutrino CC cross section d^2σ/dE_avail dq_3 per nucleon on hydrocarbon (CH), MINERvA low-energy antineutrino beam (2-6 GeV, LE horn), muon p>1.5 GeV/c and angle<20 deg.
provenance: MINERvA:2018nab — arXiv ancillary Supplemental.txt (anc/) — double-differential cross section vs available energy E_avail in 6 slices of three-momentum transfer q3, per-nucleon on CH target; total (stat+syst) errors and full 25x25 covariance (via Cholesky factor) as released; unfolded with d'Agostini method, MnvGENIE-v1 migration matrix.

distributions.cov_note: Full 25x25 covariance reconstructed from the published upper-triangular Cholesky factor U (C=U^T U, units 10^-42 cm^2/GeV^2/nucleon in the release), rescaled to the same raw-number scale as val/err (i.e. divided by 1e8 so sqrt(diag)=err). Row/col order = slices in listed order (q3 0-0.2,0.2-0.3,...,0.6-0.8), each slice's bins in increasing E_avail order, matching the release's bin-numbering table.
